meta.source: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, TradeStat (DGCI&S customs data)
meta.coverage: India's merchandise imports by partner country, every month since January 2017, ₹ crore
meta.note: TradeStat MEIDB region-wise table (every country under its region and sub-region). R print from the table a year later where one exists, else F. Country names are tidied from TradeStat's (CHINA P RP to China); the label carries the region.
